title: Recovered Metric Promotion Gate & ARCANA Target Semantic Protocol Formalization

additive_variance.canonical_quantity: additive genetic variance for the explicitly bound trait/locus model
additive_variance.required_unit_basis: trait^2 or explicitly dimensionless standardized trait variance
additive_variance.required_temporal_basis: same window endpoints or explicitly frozen aggregation

admixture.canonical_quantity: ancestry-mixture proportion or explicitly defined admixture statistic
admixture.required_temporal_basis: explicit observation time or window endpoint

ancestry.canonical_quantity: lineage ancestry contribution with explicit source lineage labels
ancestry.required_temporal_basis: explicit time depth and observation endpoint
ancestry.required_spatial_population_basis: explicit target population and lineage registry

biomass.canonical_quantity: total biomass for the explicitly bound trophic guild/spatial support
biomass.required_unit_basis: mass or normalized mass with declared denominator
biomass.required_spatial_population_basis: same geographic mask and guild definition

connectivity.required_unit_basis: named dimensionless connectivity index or physical conductance-like metric
connectivity.required_spatial_population_basis: same graph nodes, barriers and support mask

extinction_risk.canonical_quantity: extinction probability/fraction over an explicit horizon
extinction_risk.required_spatial_population_basis: same lineage/species set and geographic scope

founder_persistence.canonical_quantity: persistence/survival of explicitly identified founder lineages
founder_persistence.required_spatial_population_basis: same founder cohort and recipient system

gene_flow.canonical_quantity: effective migration/gene-flow flux or explicitly normalized migration statistic
gene_flow.required_unit_basis: fraction per generation/time or named flow statistic

managed_wild_isolation.required_unit_basis: named dimensionless statistic or migration fraction
managed_wild_isolation.required_spatial_population_basis: explicit managed and wild population labels

population_persistence.canonical_quantity: population persistence response with baseline semantics invariant to the neutral comparator
population_persistence.required_unit_basis: N_end/N_start or explicitly matched causal response ratio
population_persistence.required_spatial_population_basis: same population scope and census semantics
forbidden_substitutes: CDMetaPOP absolute response after R4.12 neutral-invariance failure

producer_divergence.canonical_quantity: genetic/phenotypic divergence between explicitly identified producer groups

range_occupancy.canonical_quantity: occupied spatial support under an explicitly shared mask
range_occupancy.required_unit_basis: area, cell count, or occupied fraction with declared denominator

range_shift_rate.canonical_quantity: range centroid/front displacement per explicit time interval
range_shift_rate.required_spatial_population_basis: same coordinate system and range definition

trait_response.canonical_quantity: explicit trait mean/response under a bound forcing
trait_response.required_unit_basis: trait unit or standardized effect with declared transform
forbidden_substitutes: allele frequency without trait effect mapping

trophic_opportunity.canonical_quantity: common trophic energy/opportunity currency under the frozen B2.1 semantics
forbidden_substitutes: biomass alone unless the transform is frozen
